correctness.rationale: All 16 spins and their interactions are explicitly defined. The exact adjacency identity \(A^2=4I+2\mathbf1\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}\) gives a lower bound e(r)>=r^2/4-r on induced edges. At r=6 the rook row and column occupancy yields e>=4, while an explicit Shrikhande witness attains e=3. Five witnesses per graph attain the sharp sector bounds. Two independent exhaustive enumerations of all 65536 configurations per graph agree in every (negative spin count, cut size) cell and fix all degeneracies. The convex upper hull then gives exact field transitions; the included verifier reproduces every table and critical coexistence value.

value.rationale: The Shrikhande graph and 4x4 rook graph are canonical nonisomorphic, cospectral strongly regular graphs; the result proves that their uniform classical Ising magnetic responses separate at sharp fields and exact ground-state degeneracies, showing a uniquely Shrikhande four-unit magnetization plateau. The physically motivated compare-to-identify-graph setting originates in the Ising spectral literature. The exact 16-site finite benchmark and geometric six-site obstruction are substantive, rather than an arbitrary isolated count.
